reference_sql:
SELECT channel,
       order_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Accessories' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS accessories_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_unit_lines
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY channel, order_week
ORDER BY channel, order_week
alternatives: SELECT channel, order_week, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Accessories' THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS accessories_revenue_eur, COUNT(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 END) AS multi_unit_lines FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY channel, order_week ORDER BY channel ASC, order_week ASC

SELECT channel, order_week, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE parent_category = 'Accessories'), 0) AS accessories_revenue_eur, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units >= 2) AS multi_unit_lines FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
